title: The Last Letter Again
author: Cyrus Ravensworth
blurb: Zephyrine Whitlock, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
